ActionExpectation.description: Caller-supplied facts checked immediately before starting an action.

attribute.description: Required only for field=attribute, measured in Unicode code points.

equals.description:
text/value require a string; checked/exists require a boolean;
attribute accepts a string or null for absence. Text is exact textContent.

target.description: Observed ref or main-document CSS selector, measured in Unicode code points.

EmulateOverrides.description:
Concrete emulation overrides for one tab. Field presence drives the
extension: only the overrides whose fields are set are touched, so a
call may change just the UA, just the viewport, or any combination.

device_scale_factor.description:
Device scale factor (device pixel ratio). Only meaningful with
`width`/`height`; the extension maps `None` to CDP's `0`
("use the display's native factor").

height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels. Requires `width`.

max_touch_points.description:
Touch points reported while touch emulation is on (CDP defaults
to 1 when omitted).

mobile.description:
Emulate a mobile viewport (meta-viewport handling, overlay
scrollbars). Only meaningful with `width`/`height`.

touch.description:
Enable/disable touch emulation
(`Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled`). When omitted while
`max_touch_points` is set, touch is enabled.

width.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels. Requires `height`.

UserAgentBrandVersion.description: One entry of CDP `Emulation.UserAgentBrandVersion` (UA client hints).

UserAgentMetadata.description:
Mirror of CDP `Emulation.UserAgentMetadata`; every field is optional
and only sent when present.

context_id.description:
Context actually returned by sync. Reusable for target-policy DOM actions;
strict policy consumes it after one action. Never fill it from cached state.

depends_on.description:
Strict policy only: observed decision regions. Target policy requires exact
business facts in expect; regions cannot be translated to facts automatically.

expect.description:
Literal conditions checked before input. Selectors search the main document;
use observed refs for iframe/shadow-root targets. Text includes all whitespace.

observation_id.description:
Sync's single-use baseline for untargeted/visual actions under target policy,
including untargeted keys and displacement-only drags. Drags with a
target ref/selector need only context_id. A script needs it only when it
states no expect facts; passing both checks the whole page as well.
Strict-policy drag instead accepts its legacy ref-map observation token.

off.description:
Clear every emulation override on the tab and restore its real
environment. Mutually exclusive with `overrides`.

overrides.description: Overrides to apply. Required unless `off` is set.

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.
